description: Native CAD/DWG/DXF files or original digital image files actually held for each target sheet.
preferred_format: Existing native format with original filename and extension
purpose: Determine whether source information exists beyond the cached 200 dpi 1-bit raster.

description: Highest-resolution scan or raster actually held for each target sheet if no native file is held.
preferred_format: Existing lossless or source raster format
purpose: Test whether printed digits and extension-line endpoints are recoverable without interpolation.

description: Existing records preserving the complete sheet number, title, issue date and title block for each target sheet.
purpose: Confirm exact sheet identity and scope.

description: Revision blocks, revision descriptions, supersession records and issue histories for each target sheet.
purpose: Distinguish versions and avoid treating an unidentified issue as authoritative.

description: The smallest drawing register, index or file listing that identifies the four target sheets and their revisions.
preferred_format: Existing spreadsheet, database export, PDF or image
purpose: Map the target sheet numbers to controlled records without requesting an entire drawing corpus.

description: Transmittal, accession, receipt, inventory, box, reel, disk or media records specifically identifying any target sheet or target digital file.
purpose: Establish file-level custody or receipt rather than relying on a public distribution label.

description: Existing release, disclosure, FOIA, public-records or transfer records specifically identifying one or more target sheets.
purpose: Identify the documented release path and distinguish it from unrelated WTC 7 releases.

description: Existing file metadata for each held target file, including filename, size, pixel dimensions, resolution, bit depth, color mode, compression, checksum and creation/modification timestamps when recorded.
preferred_format: Existing metadata export, inventory or sidecar
purpose: Compare source quality and identify exact duplicates without asking the agency to create forensic metadata.

description: Any prior or superseding version of a target sheet that is separately held and identifiable by date or revision.
preferred_format: Existing native or highest-resolution electronic copy

description: Any existing certification, stamp, transmittal or index entry specifically stating that a target version is field-verified, record-drawing or as-built; no such status is presumed.
purpose: Test status with an explicit record rather than inferring it from image appearance.

description: If a target record is not held, the existing record of transfer, destruction, retention disposition, referral, withholding or responsible custodian, to the extent recorded and releasable.
preferred_format: Existing disposition record or written record-status response
purpose: Document the remaining gap and direct any later request without assuming a missing record exists.

description: The smallest existing legend or identifier key needed to interpret accession, database, media or drawing-register identifiers attached to the target records.
preferred_format: Electronic copy of existing legend or key
purpose: Make file-level identifiers intelligible while keeping the request narrow.
